notes: The %flac macro (Puhr, Heinze, Nold, Lusa, Geroldinger 2017 FLAC method) is reproduced verbatim from flicflac.sas. The repo ships no example caller for its macros, so a small caller with a mock rare-event dataset (20 obs, one binary predictor set) was added to invoke %flac(data=rare_event, y=y, varlist=x1 x2). Runs unmodified end to end: fits the Firth model, builds the pseudo-observation augmented dataset, fits the FLAC-weighted PROC LOGISTIC model, and prints the OUTEST estimates.
